svg.aria-label: From a log file to a labelled stream: 1. Discover: The DaemonSet runs on every node, tolerating the PreferNoSchedule dedicated taint on talos-3. It tails each pod's log file on its node. 2. Parse: The CRI stage reads timestamps and streams. Relabels add the node, the namespace and, for rook-ceph, the daemon type and ID. 3. Batch: A batch flushes after 1 s or 1 MiB. Failed pushes back off from 500 ms to 5 min, for up to 10 retries. 4. Push: Pushes to loki-headless on port 3100 with an empty tenant ID, because Loki runs with auth disabled. 5. Watch: Its own metrics feed two alerts: more than 10% request errors, and files with more than 1 GB unread.
